title: Outcome Determination and Settlement Finality on Kalshi: Public State Paths, Prospective Measurement, and Empirical Identification
abstract: arXiv:2610.00165v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Event-contract settlement is a state path rather than a universal timestamp. Using a registered seven-day enrollment and seven-day administrative follow-up on Kalshi, this paper distinguishes market-object membership, lifecycle messages, endpoint states, and observation gaps. The MVE layer contains 7,611,594 tickers created inside the registered half-open interval; the reconstructed ordinary stock contains 152,694 markets at risk at the enrollment boundary, 3,477,227 already terminal records, and 11,410 boundary-uncertain records. The follow-up identifies exact public endpoints for 7,357,576 MVE market objects: 7,237,993 through REST settlement time alone, 119,212 agreeing across WebSocket and REST, and 371 WebSocket-only; 254,018 lack an admissible exact endpoint. In the ordinary boundary cohort, 71,657 markets have an exact WebSocket endpoint and 81,037 do not. These are venue-level public-finality outcomes, not member-cash observation

translated_title: Kalshi平台上的结果判定与结算终局性：公开状态路径、前瞻性测量与实证识别
translated_abstract: 事件合约的结算是一个状态路径，而非一个统一的时间戳。本文利用在Kalshi上注册的七天入组期和七天管理随访期，区分了市场对象的成员资格、生命周期消息、端点状态和观察缺口。MVE层包含在注册的半开区间内创建的7,611,594个代码；重构的普通存量包含入组边界处152,694个处于风险中的市场、3,477,227条已终止的记录，以及11,410条边界不确定的记录。随访为7,357,576个MVE市场对象确定了确切的公开端点：其中7,237,993个仅通过REST结算时间确定，119,212个在WebSocket与REST之间一致，371个仅有WebSocket记录；254,018个缺乏可采纳的确切端点。在普通边界队列中，71,657个市场拥有确切的WebSocket端点，81,037个则没有。这些是平台层面的公开终局性结果，而非成员现金层面的观测。
tldr: 该论文通过对Kalshi平台七天注册入组与七天随访的前瞻性测量，系统区分了市场对象成员资格、生命周期消息与端点状态，实证识别了数百万事件合约市场的公开结算终局性状态路径。
en_tdlr: Using a registered seven-day enrollment and follow-up on Kalshi, this paper prospectively distinguishes market-object membership, lifecycle messages, and endpoint states to empirically identify public settlement finality across millions of event-contract markets.
